You have to taste defeat to know what victory means.

Kevin explains why bad things happen to good people: to be fully alive, you have to taste defeat. Victory is always worth the struggle, and you have to taste bitterness to know sweetness.

So the bitter moments are part of the blessing, he says, not proof that something has gone wrong with you.

When did a struggle make a win mean more to you?
